headlines.title: China dismisses AI slowdown calls and blasts ‘fearmongering’ from U.S. tech leaders
headlines.description: Urgent calls for a slowdown in the development of artificial intelligence may cite a grave threat to humanity, but China says the warnings are instead aimed at slowing its progress as America’s rival superpower.

headlines.title: Top AI Developers Warn the Technology is Developing Too Rapidly
headlines.description: Some of the world’s leading creators of AI are uniting in warning of the dangers of the technology advancing too quickly and publicly calling for a slowdown. They say that it could, in the not-too-distant future, actually outsmart the researchers who are building it and pose an existential threat to humanity. NBC’s Christine Romans reports and Josh Tyrangiel, staff writer at The Atlantic and author of "AI for Good: How Real People Are Using Artificial Intelligence to Fix Things That Matter,"

headlines.title: US Gas Prices Hit Record High; Fed Poised to Raise Interest Rates
headlines.description: The national average for a gallon of gas is now at $4.32, with the price of diesel even high at a record-shattering $6.23. Meanwhile, the Federal Reserve is set to meet Wednesday and is expected to raise interest rates for the first time since 2023. NBC’s Brian Cheung joins TODAY to break it all down.

headlines.title: Pennsylvania woman dies from measles complications, state’s third death this year
headlines.description: The 40-year-old woman died as the U.S. experiences its worst outbreak of the disease in 35 years.

headlines.title: 2026 Primetime Emmy Awards Preview: Here's What to Expect
headlines.description: The Primetime Emmy Awards are set to air Monday night on NBC live from the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles, hosted by Mariska Hargitay and with the biggest names in television set to take the stage. TODAY’s Sheinelle Jones reports on how Hollywood is getting ready for a golden night filled with glitz, glamour and surprises.

headlines.title: Two researchers who left Anthropic and Google warn AI could become ‘uncontrollable’
headlines.description: After Jacob Coxon roiled the AI industry with his viral departure from Anthropic, two more researchers are speaking out about their concerns over AI safety.

headlines.title: Halloween Chocolatey Eyeballs Candy Recalled Over Allergy Risks
headlines.description: New Jersey candy company Little Temptations has recalled their popular “chocolatey eyeballs” because of undeclared milk allergens. The candy is sold at major retailers including Marshalls, TJ Maxx, and Home Goods in 13 states.

headlines.description: Urgent calls for a slowdown in the development of artificial intelligence may cite a grave threat to humanity, but China says the warnings are instead aimed at slowing its progress as America’s rival superpower.

headlines.title: Stocks tumble after AI leaders warn that the industry should slow down
headlines.description: Stock futures fell sharply Monday morning, led by tech stocks, after leading artificial intelligence CEOs called for a slowdown in the pace of developing the revolutionary technology.

headlines.title: Diesel pushes to new all-time high as oil prices jump after key Saudi pipeline is shut
headlines.description: The price of oil jumped Monday after Saudi Arabia shut a critical pipeline and talks about the future of the Strait of Hormuz were postponed.

headlines.title: The 2026 Emmys air tonight. Here’s what to expect, how to watch and who’s hosting.
headlines.description: Hollywood’s biggest night in television is back after a year of new beginnings. The 2026 Emmys will take place Monday, Sept. 14, at 8 p.m. ET.

headlines.title: Dire warnings about AI shock Congress, but action is unlikely before the election
headlines.description: Democrats and Republicans are proposing new regulations for artificial intelligence. But there’s no consensus, and the House has only one more workweek before Election Day.
